scope: Two exact current Procedure/3 records from closed007; historical data, not current authority or a full public replay corpus

applicability: Normal play with published scene and no visible creatures
Only immediate visible empty white linoleum steps; cardinal movement
records.goal: Bounded travel along visible empty shelter linoleum toward a player-selected same-level target
invalidators: Furniture, unfamiliar terrain, level changes, threats, missing scene or no position change
limits: Does not find doors/stairs or assess pixels; player must inspect each resulting boundary

parameters.description: Observed local coordinate target [x,y,z]; choose a purposeful short leg
parameters.name: target

program.source: function step(view,state){const s=view.scene; if(view.category!=='DEFAULTMODE'||!view.in_game||!s||!Array.isArray(s.position)||!Array.isArray(s.neighbors)||!Array.isArray(s.visible_creatures))return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Need image-informed normal scene'}; if(s.visible_creatures.length)return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Creature requires player judgement'}; const p=s.position,t=state.target; if(!Array.isArray(t)||t.length!==3||p[2]!==t[2])return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Invalid target or level change'}; if(p.every((v,i)=>v===t[i]))return {status:'done',state,input:null,reason:'Target reached; inspect image'}; if(state.previous&&p.every((v,i)=>v===state.previous[i]))return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'No movement after input'}; if((state.steps||0)>=8)return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Bounded leg complete'}; const dx=p[0]===t[0]?0:Math.sign(t[0]-p[0]),dy=dx?0:Math.sign(t[1]-p[1]); const n=s.neighbors.find(n=>n.dx===dx&&n.dy===dy); if(!n||!n.visible||n.furniture!=='f_null'||n.terrain!=='t_linoleum_white')return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Only observed empty linoleum is supported'}; const key=dx>0?'RIGHT':dx<0?'LEFT':dy>0?'DOWN':'UP'; return {status:'act',state:{target:t,previous:p,steps:(state.steps||0)+1},input:{type:'key',key,modifiers:[]},reason:'Walk one visible empty linoleum tile toward selected target'};}

applicability: Normal scene with no visible creatures
Immediate visible empty linoleum, ordinary floor or open wood door

counterexamples.interpretation: The initial rule yielded before a visible open door; a subsequent ordinary step crossed it. The old applicability was too narrow for this shelter route, not unsafe or falsely successful.

records.goal: Bounded travel on observed empty shelter floor and open doors
invalidators: Unknown terrain, furniture, stairs, threats, missing scene, blocked movement
limits: No pixel perception, obstacle detours, level changes or darkness assessment; choose target from actual image

program.source: function step(view,state){const s=view.scene; if(view.category!=='DEFAULTMODE'||!view.in_game||!s||!Array.isArray(s.position)||!Array.isArray(s.neighbors)||!Array.isArray(s.visible_creatures))return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Need image-informed normal scene'}; if(s.visible_creatures.length)return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Creature requires player judgement'}; const p=s.position,t=state.target; if(!Array.isArray(t)||t.length!==3||p[2]!==t[2])return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Invalid target or level change'}; if(p.every((v,i)=>v===t[i]))return {status:'done',state,input:null,reason:'Target reached; inspect image'}; if(state.previous&&p.every((v,i)=>v===state.previous[i]))return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'No movement after input'}; if((state.steps||0)>=8)return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Bounded leg complete'}; const dx=p[0]===t[0]?0:Math.sign(t[0]-p[0]),dy=dx?0:Math.sign(t[1]-p[1]); const n=s.neighbors.find(n=>n.dx===dx&&n.dy===dy); if(!n||!n.visible||n.furniture!=='f_null'||!['t_linoleum_white','t_floor','t_door_o'].includes(n.terrain))return {status:'yield',state,input:null,reason:'Only observed empty floor or open door is supported'}; const key=dx>0?'RIGHT':dx<0?'LEFT':dy>0?'DOWN':'UP'; return {status:'act',state:{target:t,previous:p,steps:(state.steps||0)+1},input:{type:'key',key,modifiers:[]},reason:'Walk one visible supported empty tile toward selected target'};}
